summary: Killingworth, CT (Middlesex Co.) 60-foot steel fire tower site, registered 2008; a Forest Lookouts listing marks it removed; no date or site description found.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts listing marks the tower Removed. No removal date and no description of the site today in the sources read.

evidence.quote: This tower was a 60' steel structure.

evidence.supports: listed under Connecticut on the Forest Lookouts site
register's 'Next Lookout Site' link is Bald Hill (US 68)
evidence.quote: Next Lookout Site: Bald Hill Tower Site (US 68)

sources.title: Beckwith Hill Tower Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register (Forest Fire Lookout Association)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the register entry and one Forest Lookouts entry were found. No build date, builder, staffing, fires or removal date were found in any source read. Register coordinates (41.375 N, 72.57 W) are given as round numbers and were not checked against a map. A Killingworth Historical Society Facebook post, seen only in search results, says the fire tower is no longer standing and that Fire Tower Road is named for it. The page would not load, so it is not cited; a person should check it. Height converted from 60 ft to 18.3 m.
